reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered by the spec and the diff, with UTC and today-is-not-overdue edge cases made explicit.
reasons.scope: The change stays within the ticket; the spec and plan docs are process artifacts, and the strict ?overdue= validation and the atomic PATCH validation are small additions beyond the ACs.
reasons.tests: Store and API tests cover overdue edge cases, filtering, invalid dates and atomic PATCH, and the one existing assertion was extended rather than weakened; the UI behaviour is only checked by an HTML string match, and 2026-13-01 and the PATCH-400 path have no test.
reasons.conventions: Follows the zero-dependency rule, uses ValidationError mapped to 400, adds data-testids and writes tests first; the small gap is that the page and API-400 for PATCH are lightly tested.
reasons.architecture: Rules live in the store with an injectable clock, app.mjs only parses the query parameter, and the page reuses the API filter.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and the validation is correct at the edges; the Date.parse check is redundant and the page has no error handling and a double-toggle race, as the agent itself noted.
